items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: Oh, Emmanuel Perez was a powerful trumpet player. Lots of time I heard him on the roof garden, different place on parade.

ctx.x: Uh, where did you, did you ever hear Emmanuel Perez?

Oh yeah, lots of time. Oh, Emmanuel Perez was a powerful trumpet player. Lots of time I heard him on the roof garden, different place on parade. Oh, a lot of the musicians I know, the older fellas, a lot of the young ones I know.
Do you remember, uh, Joe Oliver, King Oliver?
